vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes (RustSec advisories of the crates through OSV, GitHub advisories) are opened immediately at the lowest fixing version and labelled by renovate-triage.yml. The triage scores no Rust crate: such a PR always gets a human review.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Cargo.lock decides what the released binary contains (cargo build --locked): a weekly re-lock keeps the transitive crates fresh.

packageRules.description: Batch routine updates once a week.
The platform packages are nestoa's own, built and stamped with the released version by npm/prepare-publish.js: not dependencies to update.
algoan/renovate-security-actions runs the Renovate triage: its updates come in their own PR, for a human review.
